title: The Audrey Flack Short-Term Fellowship
about: Short-term research residency at the Smithsonian American Art Museum for predoctoral, postdoctoral and senior scholars of American art living outside commuting distance of Washington, D.C. Applications open 1 December through SOLAA; deadline 1 February 2027.
requirements: Live, work or study outside commuting distance of Washington, D.C.
Statement explaining why a short-term residency suits the applicant (e.g. financial, employment or caregiving constraints)
